messages.content: Could you please check for any discovered lock tickets in the living_room? Next, I need you to analyze the text "Light light_living: off, 0% (white)" and set the light_living device to red at 100% brightness. Once that's done, restart the main lock device. Finally, take a snapshot of the IoT logs workspace located at /home/user/iot_logs and send me a high-priority alert.
